history.summary: A freehold shophouse/walk-up strata unit on Serangoon Road in Little India, tagged '4BR' in just 775 sqft — a subdivided older property with no condo facilities and no URA price series. High Elo is a freehold-plus-location proxy artifact; the actual product is an illiquid niche walk-up.
history.rating_rationale: Address resolves to a shophouse/walk-up in Little India, not a facilities condo. '4BR in 775 sqft' is a crammed subdivision; $1,780 psf is steep for an old no-facility walk-up. Missing built_year and zero URA transactions mean no appreciation or liquidity read. Walk-up/shophouse strata exits are slow and buyer-specific. Elo 1399 overstates it because the model rewards FH + central location without seeing the product type.
